description.text: The College of communication at QAU was founded in April, 2003. She aims at cultivating specialists in communions, broadcasting and television script writing, who not only master modern communication theories and skills, but also are capable of information processing and multimedia composing. They will be work at science and technology spreading departments, the press, advertising departments in government, corporations or enterprises, and so on. The faculty has been working on science and technology spreading, studies on communication and script wring of broadcasting and television for over 20 years. There are six staff rooms and ten laboratories, among which there is a key laboratory of the University. The fine teaching conditions and basic facilities for also guarantees the qualified specialists. Based on her distinctive features and scientific advantages, three undergraduate courses are available at the school. They are broadcasting and television script writing, communication and cartoon. The school is applying for authorization for providing for Bachelor of Arts. It is hoped that within four years.

duration.text: The Communication at Qingdao agriculture university is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2083 USD/per year ￥ 15000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3or above 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Graduation certificate of high school Gradution certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not,it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.

requirements.text: Applicant is under the age of 25, and is in good health, high-school graduate with good marks. The HSK score should reach level 3 or above
